question: In May 2023, Prime Minister Narendra Modi has been awarded the highest honours by the Pacific island nations of Papua New Guinea and ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fiji**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In May 2023, Prime Minister Narendra Modi was awarded the highest honours by the Pacific island nations of Papua New Guinea and Fiji.
 
• During his visit, he received the "Companion of the Order of Fiji," which is Fiji's highest civilian honour.
 
• Similarly, he was conferred with the "Grand Companion of the Order of Logohu" in Papua New Guinea, the highest civilian honour there.
 
• These awards were in recognition of his efforts in strengthening India's relations with these nations and his leadership in global issues.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Order of Fiji**:

 
 
• The "Order of Fiji" is the highest honour awarded by the Fijian government.
 
• It recognizes exceptional service or achievement in any field by individuals.
 
• The award can be conferred upon both citizens of Fiji and foreign nationals.
 
 
 
• **Order of Logohu**:
 
 
• The "Order of Logohu" is Papua New Guinea's highest civilian honour.
 
• It is awarded for distinguished service to the nation in various fields such as public service, community service, and international relations.
 
• The Grand Companion of the Order of Logohu is the highest class within this order.
 
 
 
• **India and Fiji Relations**:
 
 
• India and Fiji share historical ties, with a large population of Indian origin residing in Fiji.
 
• Both countries collaborate in areas like trade, investment, and development cooperation.
 
• India provides scholarships to Fijian students and assists in capacity-building initiatives.
 
 
 
• **India and Papua New Guinea Relations**:
 
 
• India and Papua New Guinea have a growing bilateral relationship focused on economic cooperation and development.
 
• India has extended lines of credit and grants for various developmental projects in Papua New Guinea.
 
• Both countries cooperate in sectors like health, education, and infrastructure development.
